Ignore the serde span_id panic at the top, that one is a known flake in the telemetry decoder and someone else owns it. The actual problem is the warnings underneath: after the laptop wakes from sleep the websocket reconnect loop retries ~100 times a second with no delay and pins a CPU core. Make the reconnect in src/lib/realtime/socket.ts use exponential backoff with jitter, capped at 30s, and reset the attempt counter once a connection stays open for 10s.
